product.name: Stand-Up Comedy Open Mic Finder
product.tagline: Comedians find open mic slots; audiences discover upcoming shows; producers spot talent

sections.problem_statement: Aspiring Indian comedians struggle to navigate fragmented, WhatsApp-based open mic scene management, leading to missed stage time and inconsistent practice. Existing platforms like BookMyShow focus on ticketed professional gigs, ignoring the grassroots need for daily micro-slot coordination. This product centralizes the ecosystem by digitizing slot booking for comics and real-time show discovery for local audiences, creating a transparent talent pipeline.
target_users: Rahul 'The Rookie': Aspiring stand-up comic, independent, struggles to find verified open mic slots in Bangalore without spamming multiple Telegram groups.
Priya 'The Producer': Comedy club owner/organizer, independent venue, struggles with 'no-shows' and manual guestlist management for daily open mic nights.
Sameer 'The Fan': Comedy enthusiast, working professional, wants to discover experimental sets and low-cost weekend comedy shows in his immediate neighborhood.
user_stories: As a comedian, I want to filter open mics by location and availability so that I can secure 5 minutes of stage time within 5km of my current location.
As a producer, I want to set up an automated 'waitlist' for my mic so that I can instantly fill slots if a comic cancels.
As a fan, I want to follow my favorite local comics so that I get notified whenever they are performing a trial set nearby.
As a producer, I want to collect a nominal 'commitment fee' via UPI so that I reduce the no-show rate for my booked slots.
As a comedian, I want to view my performance analytics (time on stage, venue popularity) so that I can optimize my career progression.
mvp_features: Smart Slot Booking: A calendar-based interface for comics to claim 5-minute slots at verified venues with real-time availability sync.
Verified Producer Dashboard: Tools for organizers to create events, set capacity, and manage check-ins via QR codes to prevent unauthorized entries.
Geo-fenced Discovery Feed: A location-aware home screen showing upcoming comedy events within a 10km radius sorted by time and genre.
UPI-Integrated Commitment System: Integration with Razorpay/PhonePe to hold a refundable INR 50 deposit to ensure comic attendance, compliant with RBI guidelines.
Comic Portfolio Profiles: Basic profiles for comics to showcase their past performance history and social handles for talent discovery.
Review & Rating System: A feedback loop for comics to rate venue mic quality and producers to rate comic professionalism.
future_features: AI-powered Joke Archive: A secure space for comics to store and tag joke premises, preventing intellectual property theft.
Tiered Audition System: A ranking algorithm that rewards consistent performers with 'prime-time' slots at major clubs.
In-app Video Clips: Integration for comics to upload 30-second set clips for producers to scout talent remotely.
Advertising Marketplace: Sponsored slots for brands to leverage comedy events for product launches or activations.
success_metrics: Slot Fulfillment Rate: 85% of listed slots booked within 48 hours of posting by Month 3 — indicates platform utility for producers.
No-show Reduction: Decrease no-show rate to under 10% by Month 6 — validates the effectiveness of the commitment fee model.
User Retention: 40% of comics returning to book at least one slot per week by Month 4 — shows platform stickiness.
Venue Onboarding: 50 active venues across 3 major metros (BLR, BOM, DEL) by Month 6 — indicates market penetration.
assumptions: Comics are willing to pay a small refundable deposit to guarantee their stage time.
Venues are looking for a centralized way to reduce the administrative burden of manual guestlist management.
The Indian comedy market is mature enough to move away from informal WhatsApp coordination to a structured booking platform.
risks: Platform bypass (users moving to offline booking) → Implement 'Verified Performer' status that grants access to premium, high-traffic venues.
Privacy concerns under DPDP Act → Ensure explicit user consent for data collection and provide clear data deletion rights in settings.
Low supply of venues → Focus on 'pop-up' venues like cafes and bars to increase the total addressable inventory of mics.
sections.go_to_market: Launch in Bangalore by partnering with the top 10 independent comedy clubs to seed the inventory. Use a referral program where comics earn 'priority booking' tokens for inviting peers. Target 100 power-user comics through direct outreach on existing Instagram and Telegram comedy communities.
sections.tech_stack_suggestion: Use a No-Code stack consisting of Bubble.io for the web app interface and Xano for the backend database to ensure rapid iteration. Integrate Razorpay for secure UPI-based payments and Firebase for real-time notifications and geo-location services. Architecture should follow a modular 'App-as-a-Service' pattern to allow easy API integration with future ticketing platforms.
sections.monetisation: Charge a 'Platform Convenience Fee' of INR 10-20 per booking to the comic, while keeping the platform free for fans to discover shows. Producers pay a monthly subscription of INR 999 for advanced analytics and automated marketing tools. Future expansion includes 'Talent Booking' commissions when venues hire comics for paid, ticketed shows.
